title: Movement key pressed in same tick after pause still moves player
observed: With pause pressed before right in the same tick, the game pauses but the player still moves from (1,1) to (2,1). Events were [pause,move]. Replayed from a fresh game and reproduced.
expected: Pause takes effect immediately and the rest of that tick's input is ignored, so the player stays at (1,1) and nothing moves.
